answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target and confined to primary region; this matches the profile from memory_b2 (March degradation). Regional failover worked cleanly there with latency recovery in minutes. We cannot rollback (security patch is non-revertible). Adding capacity in this window is slower than failover. Circuit breaker is defensive but doesn't address the latency spike itself. Read replica routing helps dashboard queries, not write-path latency. At settlement peak with heavy writes, regional failover to shift traffic away from the degraded primary region is the fastest path to availability while preserving all writes. This maintains the compliance requirement and buys time for root cause analysis without customer impact.
